charity.charity_description:
Donations to support HFC are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

Hilarity for Charity (HFC) is a nonprofit founded by Seth Rogen and Lauren Miller Rogen with a bold mission: to care for families impacted by Alzheimer’s disease, activate the next generation of advocates, and lead the way in brain health research and education.

To date, HFC has awarded more than 550,000+ hours of free professional in-home care to families across the country, helping caregivers get the break they truly deserve. The organization also offers free online support groups and trusted resources for caregivers, while investing in cutting-edge brain health education and prevention research.

Through storytelling, community, and unforgettable events, HFC works to shift the narrative around Alzheimer’s and build a future where families feel supported and no one has to navigate this journey alone.

recommendation_copy_dict.copy:
Don’t call these Vikings cute, call them deadly! In Asgard's Fall — Viking Survivors you choose from a variety of heroes to prove your might against the corrupt forces of Asgard, then unleash bullet hell through hordes of ungodly creatures with a beautifully bright pixel‑art style rarely associated with the genre. Roguelite elements help you bend fate with randomized power‑ups that stack each round to make you increasingly unstoppable—discover Warpaints, a meta‑progression system of runes that amplify your hero’s abilities, and the Web of Wyrd, which offers a dynamic enhancement mechanic to strengthen your hero on their quest to conquer Asgard. Bring glory to your tribe and an end to the Gods… or visit Valhalla trying!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate your key on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

The ultimate castle siege experience has arrived! In Cataclismo you play from a defensive perspective, leading your armies and constructing your fortress to hold fast against blood-thirsty creatures of the Mist. Erect your fortress brick-by-brick with intricate designs, towering structures, and heavily armed exteriors to fend off waves of monsters as they attempt to overwhelm the last remaining foothold of humanity—of which you command. The modular building mechanics easily click together with satisfying efficiency, remain adaptable throughout battle, and never feel stale with endless customization options for you to explore, community-shared creations available online. Raise your swords, and your defenses in Cataclismo!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

You’re a Dwarf miner ready to explore a new planet rich in precious ore. Surely there won’t be bajillions of bug-like enemies waiting around every corner to fight you for territory? Of course there are, but that’s what makes shoot-’em-up mining game Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor so much fun! Planet Hoxxes IV’s procedurally generated map offers a top-down POV on the mazes of caves and canyons you must explore to pass through each level, complete with armies of enemy creatures and powerful bosses to defeat to gain experience. Choose your class, gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and take on an entire planet full of foes in Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

It’s you versus the house in Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers, a blackjack roguelike adventure reminiscent of other excellent card‑based roguelikes in recent memory. Set deep in the underbelly of a seedy tavern and filled to the brim with degenerates, you’ll need to form a powerful deck so broken that it overpowers your cheating opponents. Pick a suit: hearts for healing, diamonds for extra cash, clubs for damage boosting, or spades for shield boosting—and complete your deck with tarot cards, business cards, birthday cards, hall passes, and more (yes, you read those right). Hit, stand, or go absolutely wild on your way to the top!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Japanese mobsters and—pirates? That’s right! The Like a Dragon series makes a splash into open water in search of a new kind of glory with an exhilarating mix of land and sea combat in Like a Dragon: Pirate in Hawaii. Embark on an over‑the‑top modern‑day pirate adventure as the protagonist, Goro Majima, an ex‑yakuza who lost his memories and ended up on a remote island in the Pacific. In true Yakuza fashion, combat is as dynamic as ever with new “Mad Dog” and “Sea Dog” fighting styles to enjoy. Recruit a rag‑tag crew of booty‑hungry pirates while upgrading your vessel as you navigate island‑to‑island, defending your turf from cannon fire, cunning swashbucklers, and threats unknown. Recover your memories and kick ass in the process from sunny Hawaii today!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

You command time in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. This installment of the iconic Ubisoft franchise redefines the boundaries of space and time with exciting new features and so much more. Dash through Metroidvania‑style levels with your trademark Time Powers, exciting combat, and point‑to‑point platforming skills to defeat corrupted enemies and mythological creatures inspired by Persian mythology. Find treasures as your strength grows, and solve puzzles with your wits to uncover the source of your world’s widespread corruption. The prince is back and better than ever in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

recommendation_copy_dict.copy:
Get psyched—literally! Psychonauts 2 introduces a realm of madness and mayhem that defies the boundaries of reality. You play as Raz, a young acrobat with dreams of becoming a Psychonaut, a member of a secret psychic peacekeeping and research organization whose agents dive into their targets’ mindscapes to hunt for information and battle hostile personalities. The game’s third-person view lets you collect and combine powers both physical and mental while you traverse arenas of the subconscious populated by symbolic representations of familiar real-life struggles. Like the minds of its characters, Psychonauts 2 is much more than meets the eye.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

Toy Shire is a playful spin on real-time strategy and tower defense gameplay for an action-packed game that brings you back to your childhood. Let’s go to your childhood bedroom where imagination was your most powerful weapon and combine that joy with the awesome capabilities of modern gaming. This enchanting Toy Realm maximizes the fun with toy soldiers, dinosaur sets, robots, books, and building blocks for your defenses, then unleash attacks onto your enemies with precision attacks! Engage in toyfare across different maps (rooms of your house) where terrain and a number of circumstances will impact your operations. Relive your childhood with this awesome sandbox-style tower defender today! 

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.
